forecast.title: Surplus forecast & recommendation — {event}
forecast.subtitle: A simple, transparent rule-based estimate — not a trained AI model. Values are illustrative for the demo scenario.

cards.surplus: Expected surplus after recommendation ≈ {boxes, plural, =0 {no full boxes} one {# box} other {# boxes}} × {boxKg} kg

how.title: How the recommendation is calculated
how.step1Calc: {guests, plural, one {# guest} other {# guests}} × {kgPerGuest} kg per guest (illustrative assumption)
how.step2Capped: {consumption} kg × {factor} ({margin}% safety margin) — capped at the planned {planned} kg
how.step4Calc: {recommended} − {consumption} = {surplus} kg = {boxes, plural, =0 {no full boxes} one {# full box} other {# full boxes}} × {boxKg} kg
how.baselineCalc: {planned} − {consumption} = {baseline} kg expected (the hypothetical baseline used in the report)

limits.title: Limits of this estimate
limits.assumptions: {kgPerGuest} kg/guest and the {margin}% margin are illustrative, adjustable values that must be calibrated with real data.
limits.attendance: Attendance doesn't prove a surplus — the inspection records the actual result.
limits.optional: The recommendation is optional; the hall decides the quantity.

forecast.noReduction: The planned quantity doesn't exceed the recommendation — no reduction suggested.

journey.title: From event surplus to measurable impact
journey.subtitle: One record passes through every role, and every number on this page is computed from the same records — play the journey and watch the impact move.
journey.complete: Journey complete — review the impact dashboard or open any role screen to see the same record.
journey.resetBody: All demo data in this browser returns to its initial state, including changes made in the role screens. No file is deleted and nothing is sent.
journey.failed: The step couldn't run — no record changed. Reset the demo and try again.
journey.journeySubtitle: Six steps in order; each one runs the real system commands as the account of the role responsible.
journey.impactSubtitle: What was actually rescued and what reached beneficiaries, with the change since the demo started and the day-by-day trend.
journey.platformSubtitle: Event statuses on the platform, the journey event's path, and who did what, when.

hall.title: The hall registers the event and forecasts surplus

field.title: The rep inspects and records the handover

behavior.title: From awareness to behavior
